name: Godland : The Fire Quest 2
source:
Ruban Gusandar and his people flee the flames of war destroying everything he knew...
It is in the flames of anger, of determination that Ruban finds the strength to raise his head.
This fury that allows him to avoid losing all hope, his rage that nourishes him even more than tenacity...

But the reality is in his total disadvantage...

The empire of Drasko threatens to annihilate the Kingdom of Yholm land of the elves.
Will Ruban be able to change the situation?

What is Drasko trying to accomplish?
How will the countries of the world react?

Discover the next part of Ruban's adventure and search for the best way to save your people against an enemy infinitely more powerful than you.

Peace on the island is now nothing more than ancient history, you will have to fight and struggle to move forward!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2021080/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
Ruban Gusandar和他的族人逃离战火，战争之火正摧毁他熟悉的一切……
怒火与决心的烈焰，给予Ruban抬起头来的力量。
这份愤怒让他不至于失去所有希望；他的怒火甚至比坚韧更能支撑他……

然而，现实对他极为不利……

Drasko帝国威胁要毁灭精灵的Yholm王国。
Ruban能否扭转局势？

Drasko究竟想要达成什么？
世界各国又会作何反应？

继续Ruban的冒险，寻找拯救族人的最佳办法，迎战远比你强大无数倍的敌人。

岛上的和平如今已成遥远往事；若想继续前进，你就必须战斗、奋力挣扎！

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2021080/]Steam[/url]]
